decision_rule: Compute scaffold fidelity with the FROZEN measure (analysis/a12_a14.py, unchanged since A12). One-sided test: Spearman(fidelity, harden_gap_to_optimum) < -0.3 with p < 0.05 on these 8 held-out instances -> the rule survives a second frozen replication. These instances (n=13,14 and deeper triangle n) were never used in measure design (A12) or first validation (C13).
hypothesis: The scaffold-fidelity rule generalizes to a second held-out batch with the measure fully frozen.
question: Does the frozen fidelity rule replicate on a second held-out batch?
title: Second held-out validation, frozen measure
